So we need to provide estimated total payable amount. That likely includes flight cost plus maybe insurance? But they didn't mention insurance. So just flight cost.

Thus we need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost. Then output cost. We don't need to book. So we can just compute cost. Let's do that.
